title: 98% of people call this AI. It's from 1863.
hook: Everyone says this is AI. It was written 163 years ago.
specimen:
Because I could not stop for Death –
He kindly stopped for me –
The Carriage held but just Ourselves –
And Immortality.
tell: The dashes land in the wrong places — after 'Death', after 'me'. A model punctuates for clarity. Dickinson punctuated for breath. That's why it feels off, and that's exactly why it's human.
caption: The em-dash is why people think it's AI. It's also the proof it isn't. Which way did you guess?
cta: New specimen every morning, afternoon and night.
